method: verbs/critique.md seven dimensions on read pixels + verbs/review.md section 6 ten weighted categories

ai_slop_score.verdict: Gates 66-88 and 97-98 are clean apart from one residual tell: the card back kicker is a noun-plus-place label, the exact category form the brief bans. Zero em dashes, zero arrows, zero scroll cues, zero fabricated product UI, zero shadows, one radius family and it is 0.

categories.name: Visual hierarchy
categories.key_issue: s6 display element renders 30.4 px = 1.9x body; the Horai iframe out-displays the host column on its own screen

categories.name: Typography
categories.key_issue: Two headings in the 30-40 px band TASTE 4.6 forbids: .price .statement 30.4 px, .thesis-headline 38.4 px

categories.name: Spacing and layout
categories.key_issue: Document is 4019 px = 4.5 vh against the concept's own 9-11 vh; s7 never gets its own screen; paired columns top-align

categories.name: Colour and contrast
categories.key_issue: Accent count exactly two and verified, measured contrasts pass; card back and price block are mathematically flat planes (stdev 0.00) with no grain

categories.name: Interaction states
categories.key_issue: Focus ring has a value per ground and passes; .card-cta ~19 px and .topline-contact ~14 px are under gate 62's 44 px at 390

categories.name: Responsive
categories.key_issue: 320, 375, 390, 414, 768 and 1440 all read correctly; card turns to 4:5 under 640 px and still flips; no overflow observed

categories.name: Content quality
categories.key_issue: 15/15 locked strings verbatim and no invented numbers, but the card kicker drifted from the target image to the banned noun-plus-place form with no ledger row

categories.name: AI slop
categories.key_issue: One residual tell, the noun-plus-place kicker; everything else in 66-88 and 97-98 is clean

categories.name: Motion
categories.key_issue: Flip verified in pixels at flip 0, 0.5 and 1; at 90 degrees only the hairline remains; headline and subline carry zero transform through the act

categories.name: Performance feel
categories.key_issue: Not measured by this reviewer; graded from source declarations only (lazy iframes with IO mounting, content-visibility with intrinsic size, no resting will-change). perf_probe belongs to the perf reviewer

findings.title: Card back kicker drifted to Webbyra i Sverige, the banned noun-plus-place form
findings.target: kicker = Webbyra, or restore Digital byra

findings.target: 56-96 px vertical offset on one column

findings.title: s6 display element at 30.4 px, thesis headline at 38.4 px, both in the forbidden mid band
findings.target: >= 80 px (5x the 16 px body) or kicker grade

findings.title: Card back and price block are flat planes with no grain
findings.target: grain at 4-5 percent opacity, pointer-events none
